items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: And I know the family, Mr. Dennis, this, this fella, they named this particular little era behind a man was named Joe Pilot Land.

ctx.x: Like I saw them blues way back a town, well, uh, that old time, see one time, they didn't do anything back there in Polly Land, but Crawfish. You see, you didn't walk anywhere back then Crawfish, and they had old men, they had but a few families back there during that time. You see? Yeah. And I know the family, Mr. Dennis, this, this fella, they named this particular little era behind a man was named Joe Pilot Land. And he had been back there, old black man, he had been back there so long, but they named that…
Is that rattlesnake good to eat?
